content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Murfreesboro

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and years of supervised project work. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team will verify your qualifications before you enroll in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule—no travel required. All instruction meets PMI's alignment standards and counts toward your formal-education requirement for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion to ensure accuracy and speed your approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center or online. Most candidates sit within weeks of bootcamp completion; your readiness determines your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer PDU-bearing courses and activities. Plan your renewal strategy early to stay current without last-minute pressure.
